products.description: Rubi Protein is a highly functional protein from Lemna, naturally rich in RuBisCO, the protein plants use for photosynthesis and the most abundant protein on Earth. Plantible grows Lemna year-round in controlled aquafarms in Texas and extracts the protein with a gentle water-based process that keeps its native functionality.
